forming the shifted equilibrium from the unrounded sum s instead of fl(1 + s) - 1 removes the drift (2e-11 instead of 1e-6 in the same run); CORE-5... Fix: open: decided at M1-14 together with the momentum bias 10-O4 (same rounding); no change at M0 (D-054)

VAL-7 states the f32 bound as ten times the measured level; one seed in four reached 1.0e-6 (half the bound), 30 times the level VAL-7 quotes. Caus... Fix: VAL-7 explains the mechanism, states the real margin (1.8) and adds a per-step mass balance that does not depend on the seed
